construction.subtitle: Build schools, clinics, water works, housing and transport in each region. Coverage is the share of people a region's facilities can serve; it wears down as the population grows.
construction.overviewNote: Coverage below 100% leaves people unserved. Past 100% it still helps, at half the rate, up to 150%.
construction.overviewNoteNational: India's coverage, weighted by population. New facilities open wherever coverage of their area is thinnest; closures come from where it is best. Below 100% leaves people unserved; past 100% it still helps, at half the rate, up to 150%.
construction.whyCounted: Counts for HDI, services, unrest and growth as
construction.quantityLabel: How many {{name}} to build or demolish
construction.toFullLabel: Set the quantity of {{name}} that brings {{region}} to full coverage
construction.projectsNote: {{queued}} of {{max}} projects. Cancelling refunds {{refund}}% of the price.
construction.runningCostsNote: Each department's allocation already pays for the facilities a game starts with. Facilities you add cost their upkeep on top, every month; demolishing saves it.
construction.noRunningCosts: No facilities added or closed yet.
